title: Black Friday Ad Creatives for Your Sale | AIVideosUGC
description: Build a Black Friday sale scene from one product photo. Type the confirmed discount, code, and end date in the editor, then publish the version you approve.
h1: Create Black Friday Ad Creatives Fast
lead: Black Friday ad creatives are the pictures and videos for your sale. Paste a product link and get an AI script, an actor, and a spoken voice, while you are still setting the discount.
secondary_keywords: Black Friday sale ads for ecommerce

faq.q: How early should I make Black Friday ad creatives?
faq.a: Start before the offer is final. Paste the product link and get the actor and the script ready. Type the discount, the code, and the end date in the editor when they are set.

faq.q: How many credits does a Black Friday photo or video use?
faq.a: Credits are what each photo or video uses. A photo uses 24 credits. A video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can the ad start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the sale page. The photos and the main details come in, ready for the ad. You can also upload one product photo.

faq.q: Can the sale ad use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one from the actor library, describe a look, or build one from a short clip of you. People in the scene are generated. They are not real customers or celebrities.

faq.q: Can I add a spoken voice, music, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, a track from the music library, and captions (the words on screen) in the editor. The same script can be spoken in another language.

faq.q: Can I make Black Friday ads for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. You can run many product links at once, and each one comes back as its own ad. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can my own tools request these ads?
faq.a: Yes. An API is a connection that lets your own tools ask for a sale ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta from here?
faq.a: Yes. When the file looks right, publish it in one click to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta, or download it. Meta here means Facebook and Instagram. It stays in your account until you share it. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Do I need a separate file for each ad spot?
faq.a: A product photo is square. For video, pick the shape of that spot: tall 9:16 for a phone, square 1:1, wide 16:9, or 4:3 and 3:4. Each video is a separate run, and the credit cost shows before you start.

faq.q: Can I put an end time on the sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Set the end time in the editor, and move it later if you need to. It stays off the product picture, so a new deadline can keep the same scene.

faq.q: Can I reuse the scene for Cyber Monday ad creatives?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the product scene and change the offer line, the spoken voice, or the caption for Monday.
